test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A drum of water is (3)/(4) full. When 9 litres of water is drawn from it, it is (1)/(2) full. What is the capacity of the drum?
solution:
**Given:**

Initially, drum was 3/4 full 

After taking out 9 liters of water = Drum was 1/2 full 

**Calculation:**

Let the capacity of drum be = y 

As per the question; 

3/4 × y - 1/2 × y = 9 liters

⇒ (3 - 2)y/4 = 9 liters

⇒ y/4 = 9 liters 

⇒ y = 36 liters 

**∴ The capacity of drum is 36 liters.**

3/4 - 1/2 = 9 

⇒ (3 - 2)4 = 9 

⇒ 1/4 = 9 

**∴ 1 = 36 liters **
